{{Quote|Where did that ''ship'' come from, Threepio?''"<br />"''Master Luke and his patrol seem to have ''rescued'' it, your highness--|Leia Organa and C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 35">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref>}}
'''[[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge's]] starship''' was the vessel three envoys from [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]] took to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The craft was shot-up by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and forced to land on the jungle moon after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the TIEs.
